video_title: Hey, Orlando Magic: How well do you know your new coach?

quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Sean Sweeney on his boxing hobby and stress relief
quotes.excerpt: You're dealing with NBA players every day, you got to do something to release some stress.

text_blocks.speaker: Sean Sweeney
text_blocks.text: You have gear, so you actually box or you just like to watch it?

text_blocks.text: Both. I mean, you're dealing with NBA players every day, you got to do something to release some stress.
